observed: Deleting the lead technician through Settings > Staff (pencil, Delete, confirm) removes them from the Staff list.
On Board View the work order's column reads "Deleted technician" with the Inactive marker and no drag grip; dropping the unassigned work order on it is refused (it stays in Unassigned).
Tech View shows the work order in a group headed "Deleted technician" with the Inactive marker; List shows its Lead Technician as "Unassigned".
Dragging the work order to another technician's column moves it, with "<number> assigned to <technician>" and Undo.
